aggregate_support_count.description: Count or coarse grouping used to establish aggregate support.

candidate_prediction_or_path.description: Candidate prediction, offset, boundary, path, or trajectory descriptor.

ground_truth_or_evaluation.description: Target, oracle, error, rank label, or evaluation metric derived from held-out truth.

method_or_candidate_identifier.description: Candidate/method identity; retain only after ownership and attribution review.

model_feature_or_context.description: Model feature, consensus/distance feature, uncertainty statistic, or relative rank.

official_input_derived_geometry.description: Geometry, depth, gamma-ray, or contextual feature derived from official competition inputs.

operational_metadata.description: Run status or operational parameter; publish only as a reviewed aggregate.

record_structure_quasi_identifier.description: Row, segment, depth-span, or boundary detail that can fingerprint an entity.

training_split_or_oof_output.description: Fold/stratum assignment or out-of-fold model output.

provenance_limitations: The source directory is not a Git worktree, so no source commit can be asserted.
Generator paths are evidence-based candidates from local script defaults and report commands; exact commands are not reconstructed for every artifact.
The audit classifies schema/header metadata only and intentionally emits no data values.

pseudonymization.canonicalization: Use the exact documented UTF-8 identifier representation; do not silently trim, lowercase, or normalize.
pseudonymization.collision_policy: Check uniqueness before release; 20 base32 characters provide 100 output bits.
pseudonymization.conditional_private_or_controlled_strate: well_v1_ + first 20 RFC4648 base32 characters of HMAC-SHA256(secret_key, UTF8('rogii-well-v1\0' + canonical_well_id))
pseudonymization.key_policy: Store secret key and reversible mapping outside repository; never publish them; rotate namespace/key when cross-release linkage is not intended.
pseudonymization.warning: Pseudonymizing well alone does not anonymize row-level geometry, segment structure, predictions, targets, or evaluation signals.

publication_decision.regenerated_candidate_summary: CONDITIONAL: remove oracle/small groups; ownership and competition-license review required

allowed: artifact relative path, byte size, sha256, row count, column count, and schema id
field name, logical type, category, and raw publication disposition
file-level category counts and generator script path
method-family aggregate metrics only after ownership/license review and k>=10 support
candidate_metric_denylist: candidate free-form name until ownership review
per-threshold percentages unless denominator>=100 and differencing review passes
per-well metrics and any fold/stratum slice
forbidden: coordinates, paths, predictions, offsets, boundaries, OOF scores, targets, oracle fields, or fold assignments
min/max or sample values from sensitive columns
groups with fewer than 10 wells or any metric allowing single-well differencing
